## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Nikkhepavāra* (Paṭṭhāna 1.1) is the opening section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. It provides the initial statement and analytical exposition of the conditional relations; Buddhaghosa's *Visuddhimagga* refers to this exposition of the schedule as the *mātikā-nikkhepa*, citing its treatments of proximity condition (*anantara-paccaya*) and decisive-support condition (*upanissaya-paccaya*) [Ñāṇamoli 2010]. English translations of the text have been produced by Nārada Thera and Ayya Agganyani.

**Sources**
